meta.description: Emergent conversation-topic vocabulary. Unlike codebook.json (a fixed, pre-authored analytic taxonomy), topics accumulate as transcripts are ingested by propose-topics.mjs and are consolidated by normalize-topics.mjs. A topic describes what a stretch of conversation is concretely about, independent of any question script.
notes: Topics are an OPEN vocabulary: propose-topics.mjs may add new ids; they are not pre-authored and not enum-locked at generation time.
A segment may carry several topics; a topic spans many segments. Run normalize-topics.mjs to merge near-duplicates.
Per-segment assignments live in topic_tags.proposed.json (keyed by segment_id); build-segment-tags.mjs folds them into segment_tags.json as a `topics` array.
